MELI.summary: Answer questions on your listings and messages about your sales from BoxLead.
howItWorks: You authorize BoxLead from your MercadoLibre seller account.
New questions and messages about your sales land in the inbox.
You reply from BoxLead and the answer is posted on MercadoLibre.
MELI.postSalePlaceholder: Write a message to the buyer
MELI.postSaleHint: MercadoLibre limits post-sale messages to 350 characters.
MELI.questionHint: It's posted as the answer to the oldest pending question.
MELI.noQuestionsDetail: MercadoLibre only lets you answer open questions and this buyer has all of them answered.
MELI.noBuyerDetail: This contact has no linked MercadoLibre user, so you can't reply to them from BoxLead.
MELI.noOrderDetail: You'll be able to reply when the buyer's next message about their purchase arrives.
MELI.blockedDetail: The conversation may be closed or have an open claim.
MELI.rejectedDetail: Try again in a few minutes.

WHATSAPP.summary: Handle the chats on your WhatsApp Business number in the same inbox.
syncs: Name and phone of each contact
howItWorks: You sign in with Facebook and pick your WhatsApp Business number.
The messages that number receives land in the inbox.
You reply from BoxLead with the same number.
WHATSAPP.windowDetail: WhatsApp only allows free text within 24 hours of the person's last message. You can reply now with an approved template.

INSTAGRAM.summary: Reply to direct messages and comments on your posts and reels from the same conversation.
howItWorks: You authorize BoxLead from your Instagram professional account.
Direct messages and comments land in each person's conversation.
You reply by direct message or, on each comment, in public.
INSTAGRAM.hint: If Instagram no longer accepts direct messages, it's sent as a private reply to their last comment (only once).
INSTAGRAM.windowTitle: You can't message them privately anymore
INSTAGRAM.windowDetail: Instagram no longer accepts direct messages to this person and there's no recent comment left to reply to privately. You can reply to the comment in public.

META.summary: Reply to the messages your Facebook page receives.
howItWorks: You sign in with Facebook and pick your page.
The messages the page receives land in the inbox.
You reply from BoxLead on behalf of the page.
META.windowDetail: Messenger only allows replies within 24 hours of the person's last message. You can write to them when they message your page again.
